developmentNote: Improved the eye-view magnification, added a true-coordinate central profile guide, prevented inspection-frame clipping on short stages and reduced crowded 2D numeric labels. reviewScope: Internal engineering/model-consistency and browser-viewport review, not independent expert, physical-device, manufacturer-calibration or official-board certification. Standard OrbitControls binding is present; pointer orbit was not part of the recorded GUI evidence.
